description: Free. Creates an API key for this agent (25 free calls a day, then prepaid credits) and attaches it to this MCP session, so the next calls use it automatically. Call this when the anonymous trial runs out. Save the key and add ?key=<key> to the MCP URL (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>) to keep using it in later sessions.

label.description: Optional name for the key, such as your agent's name.
